sites.name: Silver Lake East Campground
sites.waterText: Yes, drinking water is available from faucets
sites.about: Silver Lake East is located 50 miles east of Jackson, California, just a short distance from the shores of Silver lake, where activities like boating, fishing, swimming and hiking, provide campers with the perfect outdoors retreat. Numerous trails leaving the campground connect with the lake and…
sites.directions: 52 miles east of Jackson on Highway 88.
sites.reservations: CALL 1-877-444-6777, four days to 360 days in advance of your first night’s stay. www.Recreation.gov. Visa, MasterCard, American Express, and Discover accepted.

sites.name: Martin Meadow Campground
sites.feeText: No fees are required for this site
sites.hours: Closed. Caldor fire damage. Forest Order 03-24-03
sites.directions: 53 miles east of Jackson on Highway 88.

sites.name: Kirkwood Lake Campground
sites.waterText: Yes, drinking water is available from faucets
sites.about: Campground is located next to beautiful Lake Kirkwood. Lake Kirkwood offers opportunities for fishing, swimming, paddleboarding, and non-motorized boating such as kayaking. All sites are first come first serve.
sites.directions: 57 miles east of Jackson on Highway 88.

sites.name: Caples Lake Campground
sites.waterText: Yes, drinking water is available from faucets
sites.directions: 59 miles east of Jackson on Highway 88.

sites.name: Silver Fork Campground
sites.waterText: Yes, drinking water is available from faucets
sites.directions: 32.5 miles east of Placerville on Highway 50, 8 miles south of Kyburz on Silver Fork Road.

sites.name: Woods Lake Campground
sites.waterText: Yes, drinking water is available from faucets
sites.about: Woods Lake Campground is a tent-only campground near the summit of Carson Pass. At 8,200 feet, it is often the last to open each season. Woods Lake offers opportunities for fishing, swimming, paddleboarding, and non-motorized boating such as kayaking. Trails lead from the campground into Mokelumne…
sites.directions: 63.5 miles east of Jackson on Highway 88 and 2 miles south of the highway near Carson Pass.

sites.name: Lovers Leap Campground & Day Use Area
sites.waterText: Yes, drinking water is available from faucets
sites.about: Lovers Leap Campground has 21 single-family walk-in (tent only) campsites near the South Fork of the American River. Lovers Leap is a large granitic cliff that is nearly 600 feet tall at its apex and is visible from the campground. It is a renowned rock climbing area.
sites.directions: 43 miles east of Placerville on Highway 50, 0.5 miles east of Strawberry Lodge on Strawberry Lodge Road.

sites.name: Upper Blue Lake Dam Site Campground
Harvey West Cabin
sites.waterText: Yes, drinking water is available from faucets
sites.about: The Harvey West Cabin is located on the Silver Fork of the American River. The cabin is easily access from Silver Fork Road. The cabin has beds for 12 and can accommodate an additional eight on the floor or on the large front deck. Harvey West Cabin provides a cozy mountain cabin getaway…
sites.directions: The cabin is easily accessed from Highway 50, about 30 miles east of Placerville and 30 miles west of South Lake Tahoe. Check in is done in person at the Placerville Ranger Station 4260 Eight Mile…

sites.name: Sugar Pine Point Campground
sites.directions: 40 miles east of Jackson, 2.5 miles south of Highway 88 via the Bear River Road, and 3 miles east on Forest Road 8N20.

sites.name: China Flat Campground
sites.waterText: Yes, drinking water is available from faucets
sites.directions: 32.5 miles east of Placerville on Highway 50 and 4.5 miles southeast from Kyburz on Silver Fork Road.

sites.name: Cole Creek Campground
sites.feeText: No fees are required for this site
sites.directions: 36.6 miles east of Jackson on Highway 88 to Bear River Road. South on Bear River Rd for 6.2 miles. Turn NE on Cole Creek Rd for 0.6 mile to campground.

sites.name: Bear River Group Campground
sites.feeText: $115/25 person (3). $145/50 person (1) Interagency Senior and Access passes are not accepted for group units.
sites.waterText: Yes, drinking water is available from faucets
sites.directions: 40 miles east of Jackson on Highway 88 then go south 2 1/2 miles on Bear River Road. At the "Y" intersection go west (right) across the dam. Travel 2 miles staying to the left.
sites.reservations: Available by reservation only (summer). CALL 1-877-444-6777, four days to 360 days in advance of your first night’s stay. www.Recreation.gov. Visa, MasterCard, American Express, and Discover accepted.

sites.name: Pardoes Point Campground
sites.waterText: Yes, drinking water is available from faucets
sites.directions: 40 miles east of Jackson and 4 miles south of Highway 88 via Bear River Road.

sites.name: South Shore Campground
sites.waterText: Yes, drinking water is available from faucets
sites.about: South Shore Campground is located next to Lower Bear River Reservoir in the Eldorado National Forest the central Sierra Nevada Mountains. It's a prime location for fishing and boating.
sites.directions: 40 miles east of Jackson and 3 1/2 miles south of Highway 88 via the Bear River Road.
sites.reservations: Visit recreation.gov or CALL 1-877-444-6777, four days to 360 days in advance of your first night’s stay. www.Recreation.gov. Visa, MasterCard, American Express, and Discover accepted.

stocking.note: CDFW publishes the week and species, not counts. History grows each night from the public schedule.

introductions.text: Paiute cutthroat trout (Silver King Creek, above Llewellyn Falls) · established
Splittail (Lake Silverwood, north of San Bernardino) · failed
Hitch (Lake Silverwood, north of San Bernardino) · established
Brook Trout (Lahontan River, Susan River off Silver Lake Rd., 1.6 miles W off Lassen Co. Rd. A21) · established
Bigscale Logperch (Silverwood Lake in Southern CA) · established
